hikes.name: Strawberry Lake and Falls
hikes.blurb: Up to a lake dammed by an old landslide under rugged peaks, then on to a falls spilling over a cliff.

hikes.name: Strawberry Mountain
hikes.blurb: The long way past the lake and falls to the top of eastern Oregon's own little range.

hikes.name: Table Rock Lookout
hikes.blurb: From Table Rock North, a 4.4-mile round trip to Table Rock Lookout, with about 1,950 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Little Mud Lake
hikes.blurb: From High Lake Rim Trailhead, a 6.8-mile round trip to Little Mud Lake, with about 2,000 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Monument Rock
hikes.blurb: From Table Rock North, a 10.8-mile round trip to the top of Monument Rock (7,746 ft), with about 2,700 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Mud Lake
hikes.blurb: From Meadow Fork Trailhead, a 7.1-mile round trip to Mud Lake, with about 1,600 feet of climbing.

hikes.name: Little Strawberry Lake
hikes.blurb: From Strawberry Basin Trailhead, a 6.5-mile round trip to Little Strawberry Lake, with about 1,450 feet of climbing.
